description: This file is a PHP unit test class named PerformanceReviewDaoTest, which tests the functionality of PerformanceReviewDao related to performance review data access in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, multiple test cases for retrieving, creating, updating performance reviews, handling exceptions, and verifying reviewer comments.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceReviewDao data access object within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes setup and multiple test cases for retrieve, create, update, exception handling, and comment update functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PerformanceReviewDao instance and populates test data from a YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of performance review list based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Tests count retrieval of performance reviews matching filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetEditableReviewById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of an editable performance review by its ID.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieving supervisor record for an employee with different supervisor IDs.

methods.name: testCreateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies that creating a review throws a TransactionException when persistence fails.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies that updating a review throws a TransactionException when persistence fails.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Checks retrieving of self-review status labels based on reviewer status.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewerComment
methods.description: Verifies updating reviewer comments and the effect on data in the repository.
